template.name: Get Table Schema
template.description: Comprehensive table schema retrieval including attributes, relationships, data types, and sample nodes for database structure analysis.
template.query: query GetTableSchema($tableIdentifier: String!, $includeNodes: Boolean = true, $nodeSampleLimit: Int = 5) { tableByIdentifier(identifier: $tableIdentifier) { id identifier name description nodeCount attributeCount createdAt updatedAt attributes { id identifier name description dataType defaultValue isRequired isUnique table { id identifier } } nodes(pagination: { limit: $nodeSampleLimit }) @include(if: $includeNodes) { nodes { id content title description createdAt } totalCount } } }
